dict.string: BrakeCheck uses the rear camera to detect vehicles and record a rolling dashcam buffer during a trip.
BrakeCheck discovers and connects to your paired computer on your local network for voice alerts and emergency contact check-ins.

BrakeCheck uses your location to plan driving routes and show turn guidance. During a trip it also uses location speed to show your speed and estimate the lead vehicle's speed while the app is on screen.
BrakeCheck records a short spoken reply after a possible impact so it can be checked on your iPhone.
When enabled, BrakeCheck uses motion readings to mark possible impacts and preserve available dashcam footage.
BrakeCheck recognizes a short crash check-in reply on your iPhone when on-device speech recognition is available.
